title: SS27 Women's Colour Stories
summary: Four colour stories for the SS27 womenswear range: Purple Reign for dresses and knits, Full Colour for statement tailoring, Sun-Faded for linen and shirting, and Living Green for swim and summer knits.

sections.heading: Purple Reign
sections.body:
**Lilac 15-3720 TCX, violet 19-3642 TCX, butter 12-0711 TCX, optic white 11-0602 TCX.**

The lead story for women. Lilac appeared at Chanel, royal purple at Miu Miu and violet across Milan<sup>[1]</sup>; on the red carpet, Demi Moore wore custom red and lilac Gucci at Cannes<sup>[2]</sup>. Use lilac for day dresses, knitwear and shirts, violet for satin and evening, and butter as a soft companion rather than a contrast.

sections.heading: Full Colour
sections.body:
**True red 18-1763 TCX, Klein blue 18-3949 TCX, lemon 12-0642 TCX, midnight 19-3933 TCX.**

Chanel, Balenciaga and Celine paired canary yellow, true red and cobalt in strong blocks<sup>[1]</sup>, and Céline, Akris and Stella McCartney dressed head to toe in a single colour<sup>[1]</sup>. "Colour confidence" was also one of the trends of the Cannes red carpet, with Simone Ashley and Isabelle Huppert in red<sup>[2]</sup>. Use this story on tailoring, coats and statement dresses, one colour per look or two colours in large blocks.

sections.heading: Sun-Faded
sections.body:
**Optic white 11-0602 TCX, sand 13-1009 TCX, tobacco 18-1028 TCX, ice blue 12-4805 TCX.**

White is the rising neutral of SS27, up from 23.7% to 28.4% of looks, with ecru also gaining<sup>[3]</sup>. "'90s minimalism" in pristine white gowns was another Cannes trend<sup>[2]</sup>. This story carries linen tailoring, shirting and the sheer layers of the One-Layer Summer theme.

sections.heading: Living Green
sections.body:
**Grass green 16-0237 TCX, teal 17-5117 TCX, sand 13-1009 TCX, butter 12-0711 TCX.**

A smaller story for swim, summer knits and prints. It suits holiday and resort drops and markets with long, hot summers.

sections.heading: Where the stories come from
sections.body: These four stories are Forecut's SS27 colour stories<sup>[4]</sup>, applied here to womenswear products. The same stories are used across audiences with different products; this page sets out how they work for women.

design_implications:
- Give each story its own delivery or capsule, so colours do not fight on the shop floor.
- Purple Reign and Sun-Faded mix well (lilac with white); Full Colour works best on its own.
- Match trims to the story: tonal buttons and lace for Purple Reign, contrast piping for Full Colour, natural horn and shell for Sun-Faded.
commercial_implications:
- Lead the season with Purple Reign and Sun-Faded; they carry most of the volume.
- Buy Full Colour as statements: more styles, fewer units each.
- Use Living Green for the high-summer and holiday drop.
